note: fe (rxi), a tiny MIT Lisp (~900 lines of portable C: lambdas, closures, macros, mark-and-sweep GC over a fixed object pool), cross-compiled to a 16-bit MS-DOS MZ .EXE with ia16-elf-gcc. It is DOS-NATIVE: it runs on the bw-board 8086 DOS service bench, reads PROG.FE via INT 21h, and prints via the C library. Packaged as media-lab project projects/fe-dos (fetch.sh reproduces this byte-for-byte). Build tool ia16-elf-gcc is GPL but build-time only; the binary links permissive newlib + libi86. Built -mcmodel=medium (fe + newlib soft-float %g just exceeds a small-model 64K code segment).
